Endoscopic Spine Surgery for Slip Disc | Dr. Om Patil, Endoscopic Spine Surgeon in Mumbai

Endoscopic spine surgery is an advanced minimally invasive treatment for slip disc (lumbar disc herniation) that provides fast pain relief with minimal tissue damage.

A slip disc occurs when the inner soft portion of the disc presses on spinal nerves, causing severe leg pain (sciatica), numbness, or weakness. When conservative treatment fails, endoscopic discectomy offers a highly effective solution.

What is Endoscopic Spine Surgery?

This technique uses a small camera (endoscope) inserted through a tiny incision to remove the herniated disc fragment and relieve nerve compression.  


Key Benefits

✔ Ultra-minimally invasive (stitch sizeless than 1 cm)
✔ Less muscle damage and blood loss
✔ Faster recovery and early mobilization
✔ Same-day or short hospital stay
✔ Minimal post-operative pain
✔ Early return to work and daily life

Studies show that endoscopic spine surgery provides effective pain relief with reduced tissue trauma and quicker recovery compared to traditional surgery.  

Outcomes

* Significant pain relief (up to ~80% reduction reported in studies)  
* Comparable success rates to open or microscopic surgery, Minimally Invasive spine surgery MIS

* Lower complication rates and faster rehabilitation
